Here is a revised version of the docstring:

Summary: Extends the Signer class to include time information for signatures, allowing for expiration and validation.

Description: This class extends the Signer class to include time information for signatures, allowing for expiration and validation.

Args:
    signed_value (str | bytes): The signed value to be unsinged and validated. Can be a string or bytes.
    max_age (int | None): The maximum age allowed for the signature. If the signature is older than this, SignatureExpired will be raised.
    return_timestamp (bool): If True, the timestamp of the signature will be returned as an aware datetime object in UTC.

Returns:
    tuple[bytes, datetime] | bytes: The unsinged value and, optionally, the timestamp as an aware datetime object in UTC.

Raises:
    SignatureExpired: If the signature is expired.
    BadTimeSignature: If the timestamp is malformed or missing.
    BadSignature: If the signature is invalid.</SUGGESTION>
